The single tick source the whole mark stack is built on. Order of preference: (1) the owner-set `markSource` (PerpEngine.sol:535), dispatched by hand-rolled assembly `staticcall` (PerpEngine.sol:542) using only the 0x00 scratch slot, accepted only when the call succeeded AND returned exactly one word (`returndatasize` (PerpEngine.sol:546)); (2) otherwise the primary pool's `getSlot0` (PerpEngine.sol:551) tick. The returned word is cast with `int24` (PerpEngine.sol:549) with no range check, so a mark source is trusted to keep its answer in tick range. DERIVED.

Permissionless keeper entrypoint that keeps the oracle and the funding index fresh when nobody is trading. Reached on every mutating perp path through `_writeObs` (PerpEngine.sol:719). observations: comment at `OBS_INTERVAL` (PerpEngine.sol:257) says filling every ring slot takes CARDINALITY x OBS_INTERVAL, quoted on the next line as roughly 68 minutes, and the note at `slots` (PerpEngine.sol:259) assumes 30-second minimum spacing; the code declares `OBS_CARDINALITY` (PerpEngine.sol:263) as 32 and `OBS_INTERVAL` (PerpEngine.sol:267) as 15 seconds, i.e. 8 minutes to fill.

reachability: The manipulation-resistant mark, read from `twapTick` (PerpEngine.sol:682) and therefore from every liquidation and settlement. Fallback order: if the oldest populated entry is newer than the target it uses that oldest entry, but only when it spans `MIN_TWAP` (PerpEngine.sol:656); otherwise a binary search over the ring at `observations` (PerpEngine.sol:663) finds the newest entry at or before `target` (PerpEngine.sol:663). It returns ok=false at cold start (`n` (PerpEngine.sol:649)) or a zero span (`span` (PerpEngine.sol:675)), which the caller turns into a SPOT mark. The un-recorded tail is extrapolated at `lastTick` (PerpEngine.sol:672).

The two-step mark: TWAP tick first, SPOT second. `ok` (PerpEngine.sol:683) decides, so during the cold-start window the liquidation mark IS spot; the open `warmup` (PerpEngine.sol:1283) is what keeps positions from existing during that window. Consumed by `_quoteMark` (PerpEngine.sol:715).
